title: Looking for Drive In Theater tileset [RMMV]

posts.author: alphawiz
posts.body:
I'm looking for a tileset for a drive in theater.  Parking lot, cars, speaker, big movie screen, and maybe a snack bar and entry gate.
I've done searches and haven't found anything.  Has anybody seen one that includes these things?  Looking for free preferably but willing to buy it if necessary.

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body: I have moved this thread from RPG Maker MV Resources to Resource Requests.

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: You can franken own tileset to build scenery like this, you just need cars and a gate. Parking can be drawn with street tileset, some wall tile can be used to draw screen. Some billboards and snack bars are also on default SF tilesets.
